# PantryLens

PantryLens is a free AI-powered web application that generates recipes from photos of refrigerator or pantry contents.

## What It Does

Users photograph their available ingredients (up to 3 photos). The AI identifies the visible food items and produces a complete recipe using only those ingredients — including title, detected ingredient list, cooking steps, prep time, and serving size.

## Key Facts

- Free to use, no account required
- Supports up to 3 photos per request
- Powered by Google Gemma 4 via OpenRouter
- Available as a Progressive Web App (installable on iOS and Android home screens)
- Streams recipe output token-by-token for instant feedback
- Designed to reduce food waste by cooking from what you already have

## Primary Use Cases

- Cooking with whatever is currently in the fridge
- Using up leftovers before grocery shopping or travel
- Meal planning from pantry staples and canned goods
- Reducing food waste by finding recipes for items about to expire
- Quick weeknight dinners when inspiration is lacking

## Technology

- Frontend: Next.js 16 PWA
- AI Model: Google Gemma 4 (google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it) via OpenRouter
- Deployment: Vercel Edge Network (global low-latency)
- Image processing: HTML5 Canvas API (client-side compression)

## Privacy

PantryLens does not store user photos or generated recipes. No account or personal data is required. Rate limiting is applied by IP address only.
